lessons.title: Choose type together with measure and content
lessons.principle: A correct size token does not guarantee the intended hierarchy. Compare rendered size, weight, line count, measure, and adjacent content as one composition.
lessons.appliesWhen: A display-led page feels timid or a headline wraps into many more lines than the brief intended.
lessons.avoidWhen: Do not inflate headings in task-dense workspace chrome or replace factual copy merely to force a preferred wrap.

provenance.source: Distilled recurring typography defects in maintained build reviews

evidence.observation: Prior builds used valid title tokens but flattened display-led feature headings; narrow containers also turned a three-line headline into six lines.

lessons.title: Give unequal content unequal emphasis
lessons.principle: Choose a section's structure from what it must communicate: a sequence, comparison, decision, object, or reading passage. Repetition is useful when the content is equivalent.
lessons.appliesWhen: Distinct sections all collapse into centered headings above identical icon-and-card grids.
lessons.avoidWhen: Do not make equally important records different sizes or rearrange a familiar operating flow to manufacture novelty.

provenance.source: Distilled mixed-width feature and editorial reference audit patterns

evidence.observation: Reference audits preserved larger feature areas for primary ideas while secondary facts used compact rows, captions, or rules.

lessons.title: Use motion to explain a change
lessons.principle: Declare a trigger, purpose, duration, interruption behavior, and reduced-motion result. A static initial state can be intentional; every user action still needs understandable feedback.
lessons.appliesWhen: A build has indiscriminate scroll reveals, generic spring entrances, or no feedback between meaningful states.
lessons.avoidWhen: Do not transfer slow editorial choreography into frequent workspace operations, hide initial content while waiting for animation, or simulate scroll-driven behavior with an entrance fade.

provenance.source: Contrasting editorial motion and dense technical tool reference audits

evidence.observation: Editorial audits recorded deliberate cascades; technical audits recorded short ease-out feedback without overshoot. Their motion grammars were different.

lessons.title: Retheme the complete interaction state
lessons.principle: Foreground, fill, border, hover, focus, selected, and disabled states form one surface contract. Inspect the actual rendered states after an override.
lessons.appliesWhen: An existing control is moved onto an inverted, tinted, or media-backed section.
lessons.avoidWhen: Do not add per-call-site color overrides when the theme already expresses the intended semantic surface.

provenance.source: Recorded dark-band button hover regression in build guidance

evidence.observation: An outline button had readable resting text on a dark band, but its inherited hover foreground was tuned for a light surface and disappeared.
